SharedBouquet.title: SharedBouquet
SharedBouquet.description: A shared bouquet arrangement including floral items, greeting card, optional recorded voice keepsake, unlock ritual config, and recipient reactions.

code.description: Unique short code identifier for the shared bouquet link.

payload.description: Compact serialized bouquet snapshot string (including optional lock config).

voiceAudioDataUrl.description: Base64-encoded recorded voice audio data URL.

voiceTitle.description: Title displayed on the voice keepsake.

voiceDurationSec.description: Duration of the recorded voice note in seconds.

openCount.description: Number of times the recipient opened and unwrapped the bouquet.

voicePlayCount.description: Number of times the recipient played the voice keepsake.

reaction.description: Recipient reaction key (e.g., loved, touched, made_my_day, sweet).

recipientReply.description: Short thank-you reply note left by the recipient.

repliedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the recipient sent a reaction or reply.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the shared bouquet was created.

StudioStats.title: StudioStats
StudioStats.description: Aggregated public community counters displayed on the Landing Page.

reactionsSent.description: Total recipient reactions and thank-you replies sent.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last stats update.

/shared_bouquets/{code}.description: Stores shared bouquet arrangements, recorded voice keepsakes, open/play receipts, and recipient reactions indexed by short code.

/studio_stats/{statId}.description: Stores global community counters for the landing page analytics section.
